newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: CNB NAMES KLUMPAR AS AGROBANKA ADMINISTRATOR. [CORRECTED 15:50 GMT]
newsitem.headline: CNB NAMES KLUMPAR AS AGROBANKA ADMINISTRATOR. [CORRECTED 15:50 GMT]

text.p: The Czech National Bank on Tuesday appointed its director of the risk management division, Jiri Klumpar, as its administrator in Agrobanka a.s., a CNB press department official said.

Klumpar, who was once open market operations division director in charge of the CNB's section responsible for trading with the interbank crown market, will supervise Agrobanka which the CNB put under "temporary" forced administration due to liquidity problems stemming from the failure of Kreditni Banka a.s..
